name: Sisterhood
summary:
Sisterhood is an ambitious project to expand the narrative of the cult classic visual novel, Katawa Shoujo, by adapting the eponym epic-length work of fanfiction into a full-fledged visual novel. This is an epilogue story to Hanako's route, starting a few days after her good ending. It's highly recommended you (re)read Katawa Shoujo before experiencing Sisterhood.

The story picks up after Hisao and Hanako's intimate moment in the park—a moment to cement their newfound status as boyfriend and girlfriend. Lilly and Akira, who had previously been summoned to Scotland, must now answer their parents' request to move back in with their estranged family.
While Hanako is, for the most part, the central character of Sisterhood, the perspective will shift between different people throughout the story. Hisao, carefully treading the waters of his newfound condition and relationship; Hanako, learning to open up to people and find her own path in life; Lilly, balancing her family by blood and her family by bond; and Akira, navigating family politics and climbing the corporate ladder.

Sisterhood is a mod for Katawa Shoujo - Re-Engineered, a fan-made HD remaster that includes modding support. Act 1 and Act 2 are complete and cover chapters 1 through 17 and chapters 17 alt through 34 respectively. Act 3 (chapters 35 through 52) and Act 4 (chapters alpha to 61) are still in development.
